$comment: Phase 4 money settings. Integer paise everywhere. Values marked founder_decision are defaults to confirm (PLAN.md §9.3). Changing them never reprices posted ledger entries.

commission_bps_by_tier.note: Platform share of each billed minute, in basis points. The astrologer gets the remainder: commission = floor(charge * bps / 10000).

real_credit_expiry_note: Long expiry per PLAN.md; the exact period and its legality need the Phase 7 policy/lawyer review.

free_session.note: Once per user. Funded as a promo lot sized to the astrologer's price x minutes; unused minutes expire when the session ends.

sessions.min_start_minutes_note: founder_decision: minimum minutes the wallet must cover to start a paid chat

failed_connect.description: Astrologer accepted but never joined within join_timeout_s, or the session never became active.

astrologer_drop.description: Astrologer disconnected and did not return within heartbeat_grace_s.

low_rating.description: Client rates 1 or 2 stars within the window.
